quat_norm — QUAT convert op

• Data kinds: qimage → image2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.quat_norm(qimage) -> 'np.ndarray' (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import quatimage; quatimage.quat_norm(qimage) -> 'np.ndarray', registry से लेना हो तो opsquat.get("quat_norm"))

उपयोग

हर pixel का quaternion modulus |q| = sqrt(w^2+x^2+y^2+z^2)। → (H, W)।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

Raw / unnormalised, following complexops.cx_magnitude: a modulus is a metric quantity and routinely exceeds one (a QFT spectrum's DC term is huge). For a colour quaternion it is the colour *magnitude* — the length of the RGB vector, i.e. luminance in the L2 sense; for a monogenic signal it is the local amplitude and monogenic_amplitude is the name that says so. Use imgio.normalize for a displayable view.
